phase_name: Flip the write-time hook to blocking

objectives.description: Rewrite validate-no-task-references.sh to source the shared library, parse PreToolUse input, and block via exit 2 with fail-open behavior
Register the hook as PreToolUse (bare command form) and remove its PostToolUse entry
Extend the test suite with exit-code assertions and one fixture per exemption category
Empirically verify .memory/** write-path coverage via skill-todo's live harvest logic
Update the rule's Enforcement section write-time-gate bullet and record discovered deploy-mechanism gaps
Redeploy and verify: deploy-headless.sh + verify-deploy.sh, confirming gate 4 passes and gate 2 shows the PreToolUse entry exactly once

approaches_tried.approach: Rely solely on root-files/settings.json for the PreToolUse registration, per the plan's literal instruction
approaches_tried.reason: root-files/settings.json is install-only (extension loader's manager.load() skips it once an extension is marked loaded); the new entry never reached this repo's already-deployed .claude/settings.json

deviations.description: Add PreToolUse entry to root-files/settings.json only
deviations.reason: root-files/settings.json is install-only and does not merge into an existing deploy; the same bare-form entry was additionally added to merge-sources/settings-hooks.json (the add-only, deep_equal-deduped merge target that does re-apply on redeploy)
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added the PreToolUse entry to merge-sources/settings-hooks.json as well as root-files/settings.json, since only the former actually reaches an already-deployed repo)*

deviations.description: Use /research 7, 22-24, 59 as the category-3 command-usage fixture
deviations.reason: that string contains no literal 'task' token and never matches TASK_PATTERN, so it would not exercise the marked/unmarked distinction; substituted /learn --task 142
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — substituted /learn --task 142 for the plan's suggested fixture)*

deviations.description: Nested task-ref-ok:begin/end demonstration blocks inside the file's own outer category-6 wrapper
deviations.reason: strip_exempt_regions is a simple line-based toggle, not nesting-aware; an inner end marker prematurely closed the outer region, unmasking four fixture lines to the repo-wide scanner
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — restructured all marker regions in the test file to be non-nested, exempting genuinely-unmarked test literals via a trailing inline comment on a separate variable-assignment line instead)*

deviations.description: Deploy via a plain deploy-headless.sh run only
deviations.reason: the headless 'Load Core' sync path skips copy_scripts/copy_manifest for already-loaded extensions, so scripts/lib/task-reference-patterns.sh (new in Phase 1/2) and the cached .claude/extensions/core/manifest.json were never actually deployed until a one-off direct invocation of the loader's copy primitives was run via headless Neovim
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — required a one-off direct invocation of loader_mod.copy_scripts/copy_manifest for the core extension to actually deploy the shared library and refresh the cached manifest; documented as a discovered deploy-mechanism gap in the rule file's Enforcement section)*
